body: Paada-Abhyangam is a soothing 30-minute Ayurvedic foot massage in which warm herbal oils are worked gently into the feet, ankles and calves. Through rhythmic, calming strokes, the therapist stimulates the marma points of the feet, which are considered to be connected to the whole body.

Far more than a simple foot treatment, this therapy is designed to settle a busy mind as much as it eases tired legs. It is an ideal way to unwind at the end of a long day and to prepare the body and mind for restful sleep.
benefits: Promotes mental calm and better sleep
Supports improved eye health and vitality

body: Siro-Abhyangam is a restful 30-minute head massage focusing on the scalp, neck and shoulders using warm, herb-infused oils. Gentle yet firm rhythmic strokes are applied along the marma points to nourish the scalp and soothe the nervous system.
It is a wonderfully effective way to melt away mental fatigue and ease the tension that gathers across the upper body during long, demanding days.
benefits: Relieves stiffness in the neck and shoulders
Supports better sleep and mental clarity

The result is a deeply restorative experience that leaves the lower limbs feeling light, warm and revived.
benefits: Relieves muscle stiffness in the legs and feet
Leaves an immediate sense of lightness

By encouraging healthy lymphatic flow, the therapy helps flush metabolic waste, speeds recovery from soft-tissue injuries, reduces swelling and reinforces immune function.

The boluses are massaged firmly so that the creamy medicinal starch squeezes onto the skin.
It is an extraordinarily luxurious, soft and intensely nourishing experience, as the warm milk-soaked rice poultices glide along the muscles and form a deep nutrient mask before being wiped clean.
benefits: Enhances skin texture, radiance and elasticity

It is an invigorating, exfoliating and stimulating session: the textured friction with firm upward pressure creates a warm tingling, transitioning to relief as the warm decoction streams over the body.
benefits: Reduces stubborn subcutaneous fat and cellulite
Provides deep exfoliation for silky skin
